item.title: Get index mapping
item.description:
Get index mapping #

Returns mapping information about one or more indices under the specified collection.

Examples #

Get the mapping information of the my-index index under collection my-collection:

GET /my-collection/_index/my-index/_mapping

Request # 

GET /<target>/_index/<index>/_mapping
GET /<target>/_index/_mapping

Path Parameters #

  • target
    (Required, String) Comma-separated, names of the collections to specify (wildcard supported)

  • index
    (Optional, String) Comma-separated, names of the indices to get (wildcard supported)
